---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability for Nido
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## User Problem

Who needs this, and what problem are they experiencing?

## Desired Outcome

Describe the behavior or result you would like. Focus on the outcome before the
implementation details.

## Proposed Scope

- What should be included?
- What should remain out of scope?

## Acceptance Criteria

- Observable result
- Compatibility or permission expectations
- Tests or documentation that should be updated

## Alternatives Considered

What workarounds or other approaches have you considered?

## Additional Context

Add examples, screenshots, related issues, or implementation ideas. Do not
include secrets, credentials, private user data, or access tokens.

## Contribution Interest

- [ ] I would be interested in implementing this after maintainer approval.
- [ ] I am requesting the feature but do not plan to implement it.
